body:
uv run alpasim_wizard deploy=local_arm topology=1gpu driver=vavam wizard.log_dir=$PWD/tutorial
failed as:
! renderer-0                            The requested image's platform (linux/amd64) does not match the detected host platform (linux/arm64/v8) and no specific platform was requested

comments.body: I tried it on DGX Spark, which is claimed in "local_arm.yaml".

The root issue is that there is no public ARM image that has been released for NuRec. I spoke with that team today and they hope to have something ready by around September. In the meantime, I've created a internal change to remove this misleading file (sorry for the confusion).
Removed that file to remove the confusion. I'm closing this issue, but feel free to ask additional questions or raise other issues.

title: deploy=local_arm failed
